Head to the Inn and talk to the Silent Peddler here (or any Silent Peddler, for
that matter.) If you have 10,000 Steps accumulated, then you will receive the
[_LEATHER SUIT_], Margarete's best armor. (Margarete does NOT have to be in
your active party to receive the armor!)

Next, go into the room on the left in the Inn, where Meiyuan is. He has a
letter for all of you; you'll then see a long scene from Shanghai, then you'll
receive the [_COATOFTHEADEPT_], Zhuzhen's best armor.

Make your way back to the church to the altar, then enter the confessional when
Margarete asks you to. Watch the scene here, then you'll receive the
[_PEARL RING_]. Now, go back to the Inn and SAVE YOUR GAME!

Go back out to the alley and talk to Hooked-nose Robin... who is now the Fake-
nose Man! Since you took part in Margarete's Confession, he is now Lottery
Member No. 2!

The ring here moves REALLY fast. And in addition to that, the hit areas are
pretty small. Normally, equipping the Pocket Watch would make it run normally,
but it has no effect this time, so it'll probably take you QUITE a few tries to
get this. This guy is special for one reason: Once you win the 10 Gauge for
Margarete, he will revert back to Lottery Member No. 06.

 - The Eye of Ouroboros fully Restores MP and SP when used. You may want to get
   a few of these, as they'll come in handy in the final battles.

 - The Seal of Strength increases your strength, obviously. I don't think they
   ever really benefit your party members THAT much, so avoid getting them
   UNLESS you've already bought all you like with your Lottery Tickets and have
   extra to spend.

 - The Dice of Caesar allow some of your allies to gain 3x strength in battle,
   but can miss some or all of your party sometimes. I avoid these just because
   it's not a guaranteed boost in battle, but some others may find it useful.

 - The 10 Gauge is Margarete's best weapon; make sure to win it, but save it
   for last. You may even want to wait on getting this until you visit the
   remaining Lottery Members, depending on how many of these middle three items
    you may want.

If you don't win, reload your last save and try again. Remember, you need to
win something from each member at least once!

That's it for here. On to the next quest!
